description: public.file-url from the macOS general pasteboard (2 items)
how: Created /private/tmp/rclip-capture/files/{alpha.txt,beta.txt}, opened that folder in Finder, selected both, Edit > Copy. Two NSPasteboardItems, one per file.
notes: The second NSPasteboardItem. This is the point of the multi-item capture: -[NSPasteboard dataForType:@"public.file-url"] returns item 0's URL only, so a file copy read through the pasteboard-level API silently loses every file but the first.
